news.title: viable/strict/1791287563: [inductor-perf] allow fusion into template epilogue inputs.  (#198809)
news.dek: Template prologue fusion lets a pointwise producer be fused into the code where a template loads an input (load_input()). Inputs that a template consumes only in its epilogue, like the addmm/baddbmm bias, could not take a fused producer. A computed bias was always written to memo
news.aiSummary: This update to PyTorch's Inductor compiler enables pointwise producers to be fused into template epilogue inputs, such as the bias in addmm or baddbmm operations. Previously, computed biases for these inputs were always written to memory rather than being fused, but this change allows for more efficient code generation by integrating the producer directly into the load stage.

news.title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
news.dek:
arXiv:2610.03894v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barel
news.aiSummary: The paper addresses the challenge of auditing deployed LLM agents that may execute incorrect tool calls or code before errors are detected. It highlights that frontier chat APIs obscure token probabilities, making it difficult to assess an agent's true confidence. The authors propose using a surrogate model's log-probabilities to audit these black-box systems.
